from collections import Counter

def feats(gi, go, bg, name):
    cs = comps4(gi,bg)
    objs=[(col,o) for col,os_ in cs.items() for o in os_]
    chcells={(i,j) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j]!=go[i][j]}
    # dup shapes (4conn, plain)
    from collections import defaultdict
    bysig=defaultdict(list)
    for col,o in objs: bysig[sig(o)].append((col,o))
    dups={c for v in bysig.values() if len(v)>1 for c,_ in v}
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    out=[]
    for col,o in objs:
        s=set(o)
        touch=sum(1 for y,x in o for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=y+dy<H and 0<=x+dx<W and gi[y+dy][x+dx]!=bg and gi[y+dy][x+dx]!=col)
        border = any(y in (0,H-1) or x in (0,W-1) for y,x in o)
        md = min(mindist(o,oo) for cc,oo in objs if oo is not o)
        # holes: bg cells not reachable from border without crossing o? simple: enclosed bg count adjacent
        out.append(dict(name=name,color=col,size=len(o),dup=col in dups,
                        ischg=any(c_ in chcells for c_ in o), touch=touch, border=border, md=md))
    return out

allf=[]
for gi,go,bg,n in [(di,do,8,'d1'),(g2i,g2o,2,'d2'),(g3i,g3o,3,'d3'),(g4i,g4o,4,'d4')]:
    allf += feats(gi,go,bg,n)
# find simple predicates true only of changed objects
chg=[f for f in allf if f['ischg']]
print("CHANGED:", [(f['name'],f['color'],f['size'],f['touch'],f['border'],f['md'],f['dup']) for f in chg])
others=[f for f in allf if not f['ischg']]
# check candidate predicates
import itertools
preds={
 'md==1': lambda f: f['md']==1,
 'touch>0': lambda f: f['touch']>0,
 'dup and md<5': lambda f: f['dup'] and f['md']<5,
}
for k,p in preds.items():
    print(k, 'on changed:', [p(f) for f in chg], 'on others true count:', sum(1 for f in others if p(f)), '/', len(others))

def objtable(gi,bg,tc):
    oi=comps_all(gi,bg)
    tgt=[c for col,c in oi if col==tc]
    tcells=[p for t in tgt for p in t]
    tcom=(sum(p[0] for p in tcells)/len(tcells), sum(p[1] for p in tcells)/len(tcells))
    cnt=Counter(sig(c) for _,c in oi)
    rows=[]
    for col,c in oi:
        if col==tc: continue
        dmin=min(abs(y-ty)+abs(x-tx) for y,x in c for ty,tx in tcells)
        com=(sum(p[0] for p in c)/len(c), sum(p[1] for p in c)/len(c))
        dcom=((com[0]-tcom[0])**2+(com[1]-tcom[1])**2)**.5
        rows.append((col,len(c),'dup' if cnt[sig(c)]>1 else 'uni',round(dmin,1),round(dcom,1)))
    return sorted(rows,key=lambda r:-r[1])

def analyze(n):
    gi,go=demo_pairs[n]
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in gi for x in r_)
    bg_=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    diff=[(r_,c_) for r_ in range(H) for c_ in range(W) if gi[r_][c_]!=go[r_][c_]]
    chg=go[diff[0][0]][diff[0][1]]

    def comd(o,tc):
        rr=sum(r_ for r_,c_ in o)/len(o); cc=sum(c_ for r_,c_ in o)/len(o)
        return abs(rr-tc[0])+abs(cc-tc[1])
    # target: largest object whose color appears exactly once among objects
    colcnt=Counter(o[0][2] for o in oi)
    tgons=[o for o in oi if colcnt[o[0][2]]==1]
    tgt=max(tgons,key=lambda o:len(o))
    tcells=set((r_,c_) for r_,c_,v in tgt)
    tc_=(sum(r_ for r_,c_,v in tgt)/len(tgt), sum(c_ for r_,c_,v in tgt)/len(tgt))
    sigs_={}
    for o in oi: sigs_.setdefault(sig([v for _,_,v in sorted((r_,c_) for r_,c_,v in o)]),[]).append(o)
    dups={s_:os_ for s_,os_ in sigs_.items() if len(os_)>1}
    def dmin(o): return min(abs(r_-tr)+abs(c_-tc2) for r_,c_ in o for tr,tc2 in tcells)
    info=[]
    for s_,os_ in dups.items():
        for o in os_:
            com=(sum(r_ for r_,c_,v in o)/len(o), sum(c_ for r_,c_,v in o)/len(o))
            info.append(dict(sig=s_,cells=[(r_,c_) for r_,c_,v in o],color=o[0][2],

    # which dup group contains changed cells
    chg_cells=set(diff)
    chg_group=[s_ for s_,os_ in dups.items() for o in os_ if any((r_,c_) in chg_cells for r_,c_,v in o)]

def analyze_scheme(compfn, name):
    print('='*15, name)
    # demo: target = largest singleton-color object (non-dup shape), verify rule 'changed=closer to center'
    def target_of(oc):
        cnt=Counter(sig(cells) for col,cells in oc)
        sing_cols=Counter(col for col,cells in oc)
        cands=[(col,cells) for col,cells in oc if len(cells)>0 and cnt[sig(cells)]==1 and sing_cols[col]==1]
        return max(cands, key=lambda t:len(t[1]))
    for n in sorted(demo_pairs):
        gi,go=demo_pairs[n]
        bg_=Counter(x for r_ in gi for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
        H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
        diff=set((r_,c_) for r_ in range(H) for c_ in range(W) if gi[r_][c_]!=go[r_][c_])
        oc=compfn(gi,bg_)
        tgt=target_of(oc); tcells=tgt[1]; tcom=(sum(r_ for r_,c_ in tcells)/len(tcells), sum(c_ for r_,c_ in tcells)/len(tcells))
        cnt=Counter(sig(cells) for col,cells in oc)
        dups={}
        for col,cells in oc:
            if cnt[sig(cells)]>1: dups.setdefault(sig(cells),[]).append((col,cells))
        chgcell=next(iter(diff))
        info=[]
        for s_,mem in dups.items():
            if len(mem)>2: continue
            dmins=sorted(mindist(cells,tcells) for col,cells in mem)
            c=chgcell in dict() 
            inc=any(chgcell in cells for col,cells in mem)
            if inc:
                cc=next(cells for col,cells in mem if chgcell in cells); oth=next(cells for col,cells in mem if cells!=cc)
                cc_com=(sum(r_ for r_,c_ in cc)/len(cc), sum(c_ for r_,c_ in cc)/len(cc))
                ot_com=(sum(r_ for r_,c_ in oth)/len(oth), sum(c_ for r_,c_ in oth)/len(oth))
                ctr=(H/2,W/2)
                info.append((len(mem), round(mindist(cc,tcells),1), round(mindist(oth,tcells),1),
                    'cc-closer' if (abs(cc_com[0]-ctr[0])+abs(cc_com[1]-ctr[1]))<(abs(ot_com[0]-ctr[0])+abs(ot_com[1]-ctr[1])) else 'cc-farther'))
        print(f"d{n}: tgt size={len(tcells)}, chg-obj-in-dup pairs:{info}")
    # test prediction
    bg_=9
    oc=compfn(tg,bg_)
    tgt=target_of(oc)
    cnt=Counter(sig(cells) for col,cells in oc)
    dups={}
    for col,cells in oc:
        if cnt[sig(cells)]>1: dups.setdefault(sig(cells),[]).append((col,cells))
    H,W=22,25
    print('TEST tgt size/color:',len(tgt[1]),tgt[0])
    for s_,mem in dups.items():
        if len(mem)!=2: 
            print('  pair(n>2)',len(mem),[ (c,len(cells),round(mindist(cells,tgt[1]),1)) for c,cells in mem]); continue
        a,b=mem
        da,db=mindist(a[1],tgt[1]),mindist(b[1],tgt[1])
        ca=(sum(r_ for r_,c_ in a[1])/len(a[1]), sum(c_ for r_,c_ in a[1])/len(a[1]))
        cb=(sum(r_ for r_,c_ in b[1])/len(b[1]), sum(c_ for r_,c_ in b[1])/len(b[1]))
        ctr=(H/2,W/2)
        print(f'  pair: dmin {da:.0f}/{db:.0f} dctr {abs(ca[0]-ctr[0])+abs(ca[1]-ctr[1]):.1f}/{abs(cb[0]-ctr[0])+abs(cb[1]-ctr[1]):.1f} sizes {len(a[1])},{len(b[1])} cols {a[0]},{b[0]}')
